documents.title: Refund policy
documents.text: Customers may request a refund within 30 days of the purchase date. Include the receipt when contacting support.

documents.title: Security policy
documents.text: Multi-factor authentication is required for administrator accounts. Recovery codes must be stored offline.

documents.title: Data retention
documents.text: Support tickets are retained for 90 days, after which they are deleted from the active system.
